subject: Procedure division structure
notes: kb/Work PB873. Every reference to a formal resolves through its LINKAGE description on every carrier arm: a native numeric formal lands the argument through the formal's profile (CobolArgAdapt.Num / NumValue, the shared Land - PB288); an IMAGE-carried (redefined) numeric formal reads the argument's storage image under the argument's carried NumProfile (GR8 / GR9 first branch) or, after GR9/GR10's COMPUTE, under the formal's own (LandForFormal sets Num = formal; TextValue renders GR10's record in the formal's profile) - so the operational sign, SIGN SEPARATE position and byte form are the description's, where CobolArg's former (Digits, Scale) pair built an UNSIGNED zoned image and -12.34 arrived as +12.34 (00123D for 00123M) on both the BY REFERENCE and BY CONTENT arm.
